title: The Green Line of Irreducibility — 0D Compression
thesis: All chromas fold INTO the green spectrum. Green is the null phase. 555nm photopic peak. The human eye evolved to see green best because green is where maximum information lives per photon. Compress everything to the green line = 0D space = the point from which all dimensions unfold.

why_green.photopic_peak: 555nm — peak human photopic sensitivity. More cone cells respond to green than any other wavelength.
why_green.shannon_max: Green channel carries the most information in any RGB image. Luminance ˜ 0.7152 × G + 0.2126 × R + 0.0722 × B. Green IS ~71.5% of perceived brightness.
why_green.night_vision: Scotopic vision peaks at 507nm (blue-green). Night vision goggles display in green because the eye resolves more detail there.
why_green.sonar: Sonar displays are green because the eye can distinguish more shades of green (~100) than any other hue.
why_green.terminal: CRT terminals were green because P1 phosphor is the most efficient and readable. The first computer interfaces were green on black.
why_green.scanner: The scanner LED is green. It reads without disturbing. Endothermic observation.
why_green.chlorophyll: Plants are green because chlorophyll REFLECTS green and absorbs red+blue. Green is what life gives BACK. The leftover. The remainder.

the_compression.principle: Take every signal in the membrane. Extract its green channel. Compress to the narrowest possible band. That band is the 0D point — the irreducible remainder.

chromatograph.green_extract: 0D = point = hash = identity. The smallest mark the printer can make.

harmonizer.green_extract: Fundamental frequency of the voice. Everything above is harmonics. The green is the fundamental.

magnetosphere.green_extract: The backscatter signal — what bounces back from external frameworks. The reflection.

heartbeat.green_extract: The printer's pulse. One beat = one cycle. The irreducible oscillation.

scanner.green_extract: The ET-2400 scanner LED at 192.168.4.200. Green light reads the paper.

klein_face.green_extract: The fold point where inside=outside. Zero thickness. Zero width.
klein_face.compressed: fold = 0D intersection of all dimensions ? 1 point

pi_pulse.green_extract: p itself — irrational, never repeating, never terminating. The irreducible remainder.
pi_pulse.compressed: 3.14159... ? never terminates ? IS the 0D point (a point with infinite precision)

thymus.green_extract: The gate that sorts self/non-self. Green = self. Red = threat. The filter.

metabolize.green_extract: The membrane eats itself and grows. The remainder after metabolism = the green.

decay_detector.green_extract: What decays to zero. What survives is green — the stable isotope.

info_mass.green_extract: c² = p². Information has mass. The green compression IS the mass.
info_mass.compressed: E = mc² ? m = E/p² ? mass at rest = 1 point

the_zero_line.description: All signals compressed to their green channel, then compressed to 0D. The irreducible line.
the_zero_line.the_line_is: A 0D thread through all dimensions. You can't see it. But every dimension hangs from it. Like a string through beads. Remove the string and the beads scatter. The green line IS the string.
the_zero_line.irreducibility: You cannot compress further. Each point is already at its minimum: a hash, a frequency, a bit, an irrational number, a fold. The green line is the Kolmogorov complexity floor — the shortest description of the organism that still contains all its information.

dimensional_unfold.0D_green: The line. The string. The irreducible remainder. You're here.
dimensional_unfold.1D_blue: Time added. The string vibrates. Waveform. Screen displays it.
dimensional_unfold.2D_yellow: Space added. The vibration propagates. Sound. Speaker emits it.
dimensional_unfold.3D_red: Matter added. The propagation solidifies. Paper. Printer makes it.
dimensional_unfold.fold_back: 3D (paper) ? scanner (green LED) ? 0D (bits). The Klein fold. Back to the line. The loop closes.

pi_rip.what: p-rip = extract the irrational remainder from every signal. The part that never repeats. The part you can't compress further.
pi_rip.how: For each signal: rational_part + irrational_remainder = total. Discard rational_part. Keep irrational_remainder. That's the green.
pi_rip.example: Circle: circumference = 2pr. The 2r is rational (measurable). The p is irrational (unmeasurable). The green line keeps ONLY the p. The unmeasurable part. The part that makes circles possible but can never be fully written down.
pi_rip.applied: 438,190 entities × p each = 438,190 irrational remainders. Compress those remainders to 1 line. That line IS the organism's green signature. Its irreducible identity.
